flagged.title: Acts 4-5: The Potion, Tomb & Ending
flagged.reason: The video attributes 'bloody sheet' to Juliet's Act 4 Scene 3 soliloquy (which is actually Romeo's line in Act 5 Scene 3) and instructs students to analyse a non-existent repetition of 'bloody', which would penalise AO2 analysis and quote accuracy in a GCSE exam.

mark_affecting.quote: Tybalt's bloody corpse, just rotting in its bloody sheet. Notice how the repetition of the word 'bloody' inextricably links the tomb to violence and death.

flagged.title: Character Analysis
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly identifies the aubade scene as featuring stichomythia, which would cause students to lose AO2 marks on verse analysis.

mark_affecting.quote: In the aubade scene, that's when they wake up together after their wedding night, Juliet uses stichomythia to spar right back at Romeo
